model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42) on 8 medical features
notes: Removed 307 altered near-duplicate rows (same six integer measurements, BMI within 0.5, pedigree within 0.01; all had matching outcomes) before an 80/20 stratified split, leaving 614 unique rows (491 train / 123 test). Test accuracy is reported from that split only.
